decision.explanation: Document D1 provides direct and repeated evidence that Charles William Taylor is a citizen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. Phrases such as 'born in the UK,' 'British watercolorist,' 'as a citizen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland,' and his participation in UK-based institutions (e.g., Royal College of Art) all affirm this. Document D2 describes Taylor living in Tunisia and feeling a sense of belonging, but it does not provide any explicit claim of Tunisian citizenship. Therefore, only the UK-based claim is supported by direct evidence.
